title: Package Notification Service with Helm
description:
**SITUATION:**

Notification Service YAML is copy-pasted across clusters and drifting. Platform wants a **versioned package**: one chart that installs Deployment + Service together, so upgrades are `helm upgrade` instead of hunting manifests.

This lab packages Notification Service as a **Helm chart** (Deployment + Service together). The point is one versioned install/upgrade path instead of drifting copy-pasted YAML.
**YOUR TASK:**

1. Create (or complete) a Helm chart for Notification Service.
2. **Install** the release into your lab namespace.
3. Verify the release is deployed and Pods are **Ready**.

**SPEC:**

- Chart name: `notification-service`
- Release name: `notifications`
- Chart must render at least:
  - Deployment `notification-service` (2 replicas, image configurable, port **8080**, label `app=notification-service`)
  - ClusterIP Service `notification-service` (port **8080**, selector `app=notification-service`)
- Default image in values: `rithvikreddyalkanti/notification-service:v1.0`
- Install example:  
  `helm upgrade --install notifications ./charts/notification-service -n "$LEARNER_NS"`
- Ready: Helm release **deployed**; Deployment **2/2** Ready

**CONSTRAINTS:**

- Chart lives under `charts/notification-service/` (with `Chart.yaml`, `values.yaml`, `templates/`).
- Use Helm — do not only `kubectl apply` raw YAML unless rendered via `helm template` then apply as a documented fallback.
- Work only in your lab namespace (not `default`).

problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Package Notification Service with Helm

Stay in your lab namespace. Package Notification Service as a Helm chart (Deployment + Service) and install release `notifications`.

Docs: [Helm](https://helm.sh/docs/) · [Deployments](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/)

## Solution YAML

Chart layout under `charts/notification-service/`:

`Chart.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: notification-service
description: QuickByte Notification Service
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0"
```

`values.yaml`:

```yaml
replicaCount: 2
image:
  repository: rithvikreddyalkanti/notification-service
  tag: "v1.0"
service:
  port: 8080
```

`templates/deployment.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: notification-service
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: notification-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: notification-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: notification-service
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.service.port }}
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
```

`templates/service.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: notification-service
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: notification-service
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: {{ .Values.service.port }}
```

## Declarative

```bash
helm upgrade --install notifications ./charts/notification-service -n "$LEARNER_NS"
kubectl rollout status deploy/notification-service
kubectl get svc notification-service
```

Wait until Deployment is **2/2** Ready, then **Submit**. Prefer Helm over raw `kubectl apply` unless you use `helm template` then apply as a documented fallback.
